name: Man Robinson
strengths: Robinson mirrors in man with twitchy feet and stays attached through stems.
Robinson competes at the catch point despite lacking ideal length.
Robinson plays with urgency — high motor in pursuit and support.
weaknesses: Robinson (5-10) can get stressed by taller contested-catch receivers — technique and leverage must stay perfect.
comparison: Robinson comps to Asante Samuel Jr. — compact 5-10 man corner who wins with twitch, competitiveness, and sticky mirror ability.
projection: Robinson projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at CB/nickel (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC nickel / outside CB — the feisty press/man piece who wins with twitch and competitiveness.
schemeFit: Robinson fits press/man and nickel pattern-match roles that reward twitch and competitiveness over pure length.
